profile.summary: Elevate Oakland (formerly 51Oakland) is a nonprofit that brings art and music programs to Oakland public school students. Professional artists teach and mentor students during and after the school day, and the group arranges performances and provides instruments. It was founded in 2011 and reports serving more than 3,000 students in over 30 Oakland schools each year.

review.notes: Same organization: Elevate Oakland's own pages say it was formerly 51Oakland, founded 2011, serving 30+ OUSD schools, and ProPublica confirms EIN 80-0717753 in Oakland. However the summary says artists teach 'during and after the school day', and neither cited page mentions after-school programming (the history page says during the school day), so the summary is not fully supported; it should be regenerated with that clause removed.
